name: Should I build a half bath or a full bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: Should I build a half bath or a full bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a half bath (powder room) and a full bath depends on your household needs, available square footage, and budget. A powder room requires as little as 18 to 25 square feet and needs only a toilet, vanity, and basic vent fan. It works well near living areas for visiting guests. A full or three-quarter bath requires at least 35 to 45 square feet to accommodate a walk-in shower or tub. While a full bath requires additional waterproofing, tiling, and extended plumbing rough-ins, it offers greater daily functionality for growing families or multi-generational households.
acceptedAnswer.description: A half bath saves space and budget for guest use, while a full bath requires more square footage, tiling, and plumbing rough-ins but provides complete daily living utility.
